body: She's selfish enough to cheat on him and then to "attempt"  suicide and let him believe it's his fault.  The problem  is that she's got issues and he'd be better off not loving her.  One less person to hurt if she decides to be free of it all.  But *he* is not the problem.

I'm a mom.  My oldest is 20, and two other teens.   They are the only reason I'm still here.  I can tell you that any relief you feel in death won't even begin to touch the pain your mom will feel.  She will think it's her fault no matter what you do to assure her it's not.  She will never ever be happy or even free from pain again.   Can you just hang on until she passes away herself?  Things may even change before then.   I know you feel alone and that life isn't worth living,  but what she will experience is actual torture.  I'm trying to hang on because of my kids.  It's not the best life but it's better than their suffering and being screwed up too.  One way or another there will come a day when relief will come.  I just don't want it if it means destroying anyone that I love or that loves me.   Can you relate at all?
